```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
options(HTTPUserAgent = "3MB001-course", timeout = 60)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE)
use_snapshot <- FALSE
snapshot_date <- "2026-11-18"
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
provenance <- data.frame(dataset = character(), mode = character(),
                         retrieved = character(), version = character())

# Daily cache includes provenance. Failures use the named snapshot, never
# unlabelled made-up data. Missing or malformed snapshots stop the report.
load_data <- function(name, snapshot, fetch_fun, snapshot_version,
                      snapshot_read = function(path) {
                        read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                                 na.strings = character())
                      }) {
  cache <- file.path("data", paste0(name, "-", Sys.Date(), ".rds"))
  if (use_snapshot) {
    obj <- list(data = snapshot_read(snapshot), mode = "course snapshot",
                retrieved = snapshot_date, version = snapshot_version)
  } else if (file.exists(cache)) {
    obj <- readRDS(cache)
    obj$mode <- paste("cached", obj$mode)
  } else {
    obj <- tryCatch({
      value <- fetch_fun()
      version <- attr(value, "source_version")
      if (is.null(version)) version <- "not reported"
      result <- list(data = value, mode = "live API", retrieved = as.character(Sys.Date()),
                     version = version)
      saveRDS(result, cache)
      result
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("API unavailable:", conditionMessage(e), "Using course snapshot."))
      list(data = snapshot_read(snapshot), mode = "fallback snapshot",
           retrieved = snapshot_date, version = snapshot_version)
    })
  }
  provenance <<- rbind(provenance, data.frame(dataset = name, mode = obj$mode,
                         retrieved = obj$retrieved, version = obj$version))
  obj$data
}
uniprot_release <- function(url) {
  headers <- tryCatch(curlGetHeaders(url), error = function(e) character())
  h <- headers[grepl("^x-uniprot-release:", headers, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  if (length(h)) trimws(sub("^[^:]+:", "", tail(h, 1))) else "not reported"
}
count_feature <- function(x, token) {
  vapply(gregexpr(token, x, fixed = TRUE), function(pos) sum(pos > 0), integer(1))
}
```

# Data: GTEx tissue expression

The code makes four small requests: a reference lookup and an expression query
for each gene. Inspect `jsonlite::fromJSON()` on one URL to see how JSON maps to
an R list. The query pins GTEx v8 and resolves each versioned GENCODE identifier.

```{r fetch-gtex}
library(jsonlite)
gtex_base <- "https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/"
gtex_dataset <- "gtex_v8"
fetch_gtex <- function() {
  result <- lapply(c("SLC5A1", "SLC5A2"), function(gene) {
    gene_url <- paste0(gtex_base, "reference/gene?geneId=", gene,
                       "&datasetId=", gtex_dataset)
    reference <- jsonlite::fromJSON(gene_url)
    genes <- reference$data
    hit <- genes[genes$geneSymbol == gene, , drop = FALSE]
    stopifnot(nrow(hit) == 1)
    gene_id <- hit$gencodeId[1]
    expression_url <- paste0(gtex_base, "expression/medianGeneExpression?gencodeId=",
                              gene_id, "&datasetId=", gtex_dataset)
    response <- jsonlite::fromJSON(expression_url)
    # Never silently analyse only the first page.
    if (!is.null(response$paging_info$numberOfPages) &&
        response$paging_info$numberOfPages > 1) stop("GTEx response needs pagination")
    x <- response$data
    stopifnot(nrow(x) > 0, all(x$unit == "TPM"))
    data.frame(gene = gene, gencode_id = gene_id,
               tissue = x$tissueSiteDetailId, median_tpm = x$median)
  })
  value <- do.call(rbind, result)
  attr(value, "source_version") <- gtex_dataset
  value
}
expression <- load_data("gtex-medians", "data/gtex-medians-2026-11-18.csv",
                        fetch_gtex, "gtex_v8")
stopifnot(all(c("gene", "gencode_id", "tissue", "median_tpm") %in% names(expression)),
          setequal(unique(expression$gene), c("SLC5A1", "SLC5A2")),
          !anyDuplicated(expression[c("gene", "tissue")]),
          all(is.finite(expression$median_tpm)), all(expression$median_tpm >= 0))
head(expression)
```

## Plot tissue expression

Only include tissues with a median above 10 TPM for either gene. These data are
tissue medians of RNA abundance, not per-cell protein measurements.

```{r select-tissues}
plot_tissues <- unique(expression$tissue[expression$median_tpm > 10])
plot_expression <- expression[expression$tissue %in% plot_tissues, ]
```

```{r expression-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
ggplot(plot_expression, aes(tissue, median_tpm, colour = gene)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 3) +
  coord_flip() + theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Tissue", y = "Median RNA abundance (TPM)", colour = "Gene",
       caption = paste("Source: GTEx v8;", provenance$mode[1],
                       "retrieved", provenance$retrieved[1]))
```

```{r highest-tissue}
highest <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(expression, expression$gene),
  function(x) x[which.max(x$median_tpm), c("gene", "tissue", "median_tpm")]))
knitr::kable(highest)
```

The SLC5A2 maximum is `r round(max(expression$median_tpm[expression$gene == "SLC5A2"]), 1)`
TPM in kidney cortex. SGLT2 participates in renal glucose reabsorption, consistent
with kidney-enriched RNA. SLC5A1 is highest in terminal ileum (~98 TPM), fitting
intestinal absorption; the substantial heart RNA is a reminder that familiar
functions do not exhaust a gene's expression pattern. Bulk RNA does not identify
the expressing cell type or the membrane surface containing the protein.

# Data: UniProt membrane features

This single query returns eight proteins. API feature names differ from the
column labels in the response. `check.names = FALSE` preserves those labels.

```{r fetch-uniprot}
accessions <- c("P05023", "P11166", "P13866", "P31639", "P08183", "P13569",
                "P29972", "Q09470")
uniprot_url <- paste0("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/accessions?accessions=",
  paste(accessions, collapse = ","),
  "&fields=accession,gene_primary,ft_transmem,ft_topo_dom,length&format=tsv")
fetch_uniprot <- function() {
  x <- read.delim(uniprot_url, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                  na.strings = character(), quote = "")
  stopifnot(setequal(x$Entry, accessions))
  attr(x, "source_version") <- uniprot_release(uniprot_url)
  x
}
proteins <- load_data("uniprot-features", "data/uniprot-features-2026-11-18.csv",
                      fetch_uniprot, "UniProtKB 2026_04")
stopifnot(setequal(proteins$Entry, accessions),
          all(c("Gene Names (primary)", "Transmembrane") %in% names(proteins)))
proteins$gene <- proteins[["Gene Names (primary)"]]
head(proteins[c("Entry", "gene", "Length")])
```

## Count and plot transmembrane segments

Count `TRANSMEM ` occurrences, not semicolons (a feature has several qualifiers).
The helper `count_feature()` shows how to handle the no-match value -1.

```{r count-tm}
proteins$tm_count <- count_feature(proteins$Transmembrane, "TRANSMEM ")
knitr::kable(proteins[c("gene", "tm_count")])
stopifnot(proteins$tm_count[proteins$gene == "CFTR"] == 12,
          proteins$tm_count[proteins$gene == "SLC5A2"] == 14)
```

```{r topology-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
ggplot(proteins, aes(reorder(gene, tm_count), tm_count)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#207a72") + coord_flip() + theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Gene", y = "Annotated transmembrane segments (count)",
       caption = paste("Source: UniProtKB;", tail(provenance$version, 1),
                       "retrieved", tail(provenance$retrieved, 1)))
```

CFTR and ABCB1 both have 12 annotated segments but CFTR is a channel and ABCB1 an ATP-driven exporter. Topology alone does not identify transport mechanism.

# Data provenance and sources

The analysis ran on `r Sys.Date()`. The table records the date the data were
retrieved, which may differ from the knitting date. The snapshot was downloaded
on 2026-11-18; a live request reports its own date and version. Cache files store
this information alongside the data.

```{r provenance}
knitr::kable(provenance)
cat("UniProt query:", uniprot_url, "\n")
cat("GTEx reference endpoint:", paste0(gtex_base, "reference/gene"), "\n")
cat("GTEx expression endpoint:", paste0(gtex_base, "expression/medianGeneExpression"),
    "; dataset:", gtex_dataset, "\n")
print(unique(expression[c("gene", "gencode_id")]))
```
